title: Controls Software Development Engineer
description:
12 Months (Renewable)
Domain: Manufacturing Operations / Industrial Automation Role Overview CS TECH Ai is seeking a Controls Software Development Engineer to bridge traditional industrial automation with modern software engineering. The role focuses on developing software tools that automate the deployment, retrieval, backup, comparison, and version control of shop-floor programs for PLCs, industrial robots, and CNC machines. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on PLC programming and industrial automation expertise with strong software development skills in C#/.NET and Python. The objective is to replace manual engineering activities with secure, reliable, repeatable, and auditable workflows while maintaining production safety and manufacturing uptime. Key Responsibilities 1. Industrial Automation Tool Development Design, develop, and maintain software utilities to automate program uploads, downloads, retrieval, backup, and deployment for Siemens PLCs, Rockwell PLCs, ABB robots, and CNC systems. Develop integrations with Siemens TIA Portal Openness, Rockwell Studio 5000 automation interfaces and SDKs, and ABB Robot SDKs or Robot Web Services. Automate engineering workflows for PLC logic, robot programs, and CNC part programs to reduce manual intervention and improve operational consistency. Develop reusable software components and automation frameworks that support multiple device types and engineering environments.
